question: On WSLc 3.0.3 with private Xvfb, can the current-main standard caller preserve independently verified release and task oracles at a 3860 ms X-server pause under the unchanged 4 s transaction deadline?

conditions.runtime: WSLc isolated session and container on user-authorized PC

decision: PASS only if local XRes preflight passes before test input; public caller exits zero; 3860 ms pause is observed; release receipt precedes the exact 4000 ms deadline; independently sampled all-keys-up readback is <=5000 ms; horizon >=8500 ms has no delayed key; old and fresh task oracles pass; old status remains UNKNOWN with replay denied; exact container/session/image cleanup succeeds. Any setup/preflight failure is zero-input and is never retried.
replication_of: R46 3860 ms Docker Desktop caller test; exact test and runtime source blobs must match current-main hashes
limits: Synthetic private Xvfb only; no physical desktop, MAP01, real application, efficiency comparison, or reliability generalization.
